hook.en: The weather forecast, the cricket run rate, the price of your insurance and the medicine you take were all decided with statistics.

title.en: Statistics in planning, economics and business

body.en: Planning: the government needs data on population, production and employment to fix targets of plans and budgets. Economics: national income, price index numbers and inflation are statistical measures; econometrics tests economic theories with data. Business: market surveys, sales forecasting and inventory control rest on statistics.
body.kn: ಯೋಜನೆ: ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ, ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ, ಉದ್ಯೋಗದ ದತ್ತಾಂಶದಿಂದ ಗುರಿಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅರ್ಥಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಆದಾಯ, ಬೆಲೆ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕಗಳು. ವ್ಯವಹಾರ: ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಸಮೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರಾಟ ಮುನ್ಸೂಚನೆ.

say.en: Statistics sits at the centre and serves many fields.
Planning and business use it to fix targets and forecast sales.
Economics uses national income and price indices; industry uses quality control.
Agriculture estimates crop yields; medicine tests drugs with trials.

narration.en: On the board: Statistics at the centre.
Match each field with a use of statistics in it.

right.en: Fixing the targets of a five-year plan
National income and price index numbers
Clinical trials of a new drug

explanation.en: Planning needs targets, economics measures national income and prices, business uses market surveys, industry uses quality control charts, agriculture uses crop-cutting experiments, medicine uses clinical trials and insurance uses life tables.

body.en: Industry: statistical quality control (SQC) checks products with control charts and sampling inspection. Agriculture: crop yields are estimated by crop-cutting experiments, and new seeds and fertilisers are compared by designed experiments. Medicine: clinical trials test whether a drug works. Insurance: actuarial science uses life tables to fix premiums. Banks, weather offices and sports also depend on statistics.
body.kn: ಕೈಗಾರಿಕೆ: ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ (SQC). ಕೃಷಿ: ಬೆಳೆ ಕಟಾವು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳಿಂದ ಇಳುವರಿ ಅಂದಾಜು. ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ: ಔಷಧಿಯ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ. ವಿಮೆ: ಜೀವ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕಗಳಿಂದ ಕಂತು ನಿಗದಿ (ವಿಮಾಗಣಿತ).
